line: A cinema newsreel: brisk monochrome actuality, title cards with a date, a brass band and a confident announcer.
line_cn: 影院新闻片：明快的黑白实况、带日期的字幕卡、铜管乐队和自信的播音员。
lineage: Structure after lemo-opuscar STYLE.md (CC BY 4.0); text written for the H3 pipeline.
essence: Monochrome actuality footage: crowds, streets, factories, parades, slightly fast.
Title cards with a dateline and a headline between items; an announcer over the picture.
Brisk cutting; every item short; a brass march underneath.
Print damage, flicker, a vignette; the camera mostly locked on a tripod.
not: Not a silent comedy: there is a voice and music throughout.
Not a modern documentary: no interviews, no handheld.
Not sepia nostalgia: silver greys, high contrast.
materials: 35 mm nitrate look: grain, scratches, flicker, soft halation.
Period streets, crowds, machines, costume; painted signs allowed but illegible.

rules: Monochrome silver, high contrast, slight flicker.
No tinting; the cards are white on black.
Values: pale skies, dark crowds, bright faces.

type.titleFont: a condensed Gothic or Art Deco display face, white on black with a border
type.subtitleFont: not used; the announcer carries the words
type.placement: a dateline card before each item; a headline card between items; by the assembler
rules: Cards are 3–4 s; never text over the picture.
Slightly fast (undercranked) action; crowds move briskly.
Cut every 3–6 s inside an item; items 10–20 s each.
The music drives the pace; the announcer never pauses.

grammar.note: slow, across a crowd or a line of machines
up a new building or machine
from a car or a train

framing: Wide and medium tripod shots; people look at the camera sometimes.

foley: all thin and band-limited like optical sound
sound.ambience: optical-track hiss and crackle under everything
sound.silence: none inside items; a beat of hiss on the card between items
sound.voice: a mid-Atlantic announcer, fast, confident, never pausing; band-limited
sound.musicDefault: brass band march, optical-track thin, continuous

nativeMoves.name: The dateline card
nativeMoves.what: A card with place and date opens every item.
nativeMoves.build: assembler title card before the item's first shot; hiss on the card.

nativeMoves.name: The demonstration
nativeMoves.what: A person shows the thing to the camera.
nativeMoves.build: ms static shot, reference mode for the demonstrator, one action per beat.

nativeMoves.name: The crowd pan
nativeMoves.what: A slow pan proves the numbers.
nativeMoves.build: pan move, els, pace brisk, vfx none.

nativeMoves.name: The stunt
nativeMoves.what: A brief daring act, cut short.
nativeMoves.build: a 5 s montage shot, cut on the beat, undercranked.

pitfalls.problem: The footage looks modern and clean.
pitfalls.fix: texture 8mm or 16mm, grade mono; 'scratched 1920s newsreel print, slightly fast' in the suffix.
No dialogue field; the announcer is a narration track added by the assembler.
Negatives 'no readable text'; describe 'painted period signs'.

look.genre: 1920s cinema newsreel, monochrome actuality, brisk and upbeat
look.palette: high-contrast silver monochrome, flicker, pale skies, no tint
look.camera: tripod wides and mediums, slow crowd pans, a tracking shot from a car

engine.beatSuffix: A flickering 1920s newsreel print, slightly fast crowds, tripod framing.

structures: one event covered from three cities
a fad's rise and fall in four cards
openings: the fanfare and the newsreel's own title card
a crowd pan with the announcer already talking
endings: the band's last chord on a card
